claim_summaries: Immutable INITIAL proves a dimension-free energy-to-pairwise-commutator bound for a positive selfadjoint tracial selfcompatible channel with an actual broadcaster.

REVISION-01 proves a size-free random-shift block coarsening for one pivot and an arbitrarily large weighted family, then combines it with INITIAL to obtain a family-size-independent block-algebra approximation of order average-energy^(1/3).

Balanced-sign example exactly shows one/fixed-size block-center EB refinements can have loss tending to one despite zero pairwise commutators; it is not a counterexample to a full common-basis EB map.
REVISION-02 independently verifies the EB-square power identity and rejects selfcompatibility implying EB square using the universal qubit cloner marginal.
